The following permissions are supported in data access policies. For the OpenSearch API
operations that each permission allows, see the section called “Supported OpenSearch API
operations and permissions”.
Collection permissions
• aoss:CreateCollectionItems
• aoss:DeleteCollectionItems
• aoss:UpdateCollectionItems
• aoss:DescribeCollectionItems
• aoss:*
Index permissions
• aoss:ReadDocument
• aoss:WriteDocument
• aoss:CreateIndex
• aoss:DeleteIndex
• aoss:UpdateIndex
